title: Fourier regularity and junta covariance
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f:{-1,1}^n\to\mathbb R$. The Fourier coefficients of $f$ vanish on every nonempty set of at most $k$ coordinates if and only if $f$ has covariance zero with every sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube that depends on at most $k$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
The tested coordinate sets are nonempty and have cardinality at most $k$
The comparison functions are sign-valued and depend on at most $k$ coordinates
